product_metadata.title: Update International PC-F102 Cellophane Frill Toothpicks, 4-Inch 1000 count
description: Both practical and fun, Update International's Cellophane Frill toothpicks are a great addition to your deli, diner, or bar. The 4 inch length makes them perfect for holding tall sandwiches and wraps together. Bright cellophane tops stand out atop burgers, adding a classic touch to lunches and dinners. Colorful cellophane toothpicks can be just as useful behind the bar. Use the red, blue, green, and yellow cellophane to color-code drinks. Spear cherries, olives, and other bar condiments to make festive looking cocktails.
